title: Herbal Dense American Pork Skillet
description: A date-night American dish featuring pork, mustard seeds, and herbs, perfect for a romantic dinner. This recipe combines the richness of pork with the freshness of herbs and the crunch of blanched vegetables.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, thyme, and rosemary.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the pork for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
While the pork is cooking, blanch the broccoli and red bell pepper in boiling water for 3-5 minutes, or until tender but still crisp.
In a small bowl, mix together the mustard seeds and a pinch of salt.
Remove the pork from the oven and sprinkle the mustard seed mixture evenly over the top.
Return the skillet to the stovetop over medium heat and add the garlic, cooking for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the blanched broccoli and red bell pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine with the garlic and pork juices.
